name: omnisense/omnimeet
description: Omnimeet: one contract for video meetings - open a room, let a participant in (a JavaScript engine and its options, an embedded frame, or an address), close it, read its state, hear the provider's callbacks - whatever carries the call: the two browsers themselves (omnimeet/direct) or a conferencing service (omnimeet/jitsi) - each gateway with its usage policy (omnisense/contracts: what its terms allow, its limits, enforced by a guard); and its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnimeet/direct: From browser to browser: two people, end to end, no third party - the default gateway, no key
suggest.omnimeet/jitsi: Jitsi Meet: a self-hosted or hosted instance, a token per participant, an embedded frame, several people
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Omnimeet\Testing\BareTestCase: the bare check of a gateway package (omnisense/contracts' kernel)
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnimeet\Bridge\Symfony\OmnimeetBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnimeet\Bridge\Symfony\OmnimeetBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnimeet\Bridge\Symfony\OmnimeetBundle itself
